entries.title: Basic Anatomy Review

testable_competencies.anatomy: Foundational pelvic/obstetric anatomy that frames chapter content but is not independently tested.

entries.zero_question_reason: Specialist-technique, reference/EBM-summary, or foundational-background content with no independently testable generalist competency identified; not planned for dedicated question coverage at this scope stage.

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Recognizing normal pregnancy physiologic adaptations (cardiovascular, renal, respiratory, hematologic) from pathology is implicit in providing evidence-based prenatal care and shared decision-making across pregnancy.

testable_competencies.normal_vs_pathologic: Distinguish expected physiologic changes of pregnancy (e.g., dilutional anemia, physiologic edema, supine hypotension, increased cardiac output) from pathologic findings.

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Confirming and dating a pregnancy (beta-hCG interpretation, first-trimester ultrasound dating) is the entry point into the prenatal care encounter this objective covers.

testable_competencies.pregnancy_diagnosis: Interpret serum/urine beta-hCG and first-trimester ultrasound findings to confirm and date a pregnancy.

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Objective 80-1's own scope explicitly names 'preconception' alongside pregnancy and fetal health as a domain of shared decision-making prenatal care.

testable_competencies.preconception_counselling: Counsel a patient planning pregnancy on folic acid supplementation, immunization status, medication review, and modifiable risk factors.

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: The initial prenatal visit (history, physical, baseline investigations, dating) is the core clinical encounter this objective describes.

testable_competencies.initial_visit: Perform and interpret the components of an initial prenatal visit, including baseline history, physical exam, and first-trimester investigations.

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Nausea and vomiting of pregnancy is a named, high-prevalence cause the candidate must recognize and distinguish from more serious etiologies of vomiting/nausea.

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Managing common pregnancy symptoms is part of routine prenatal care.

testable_competencies.nvp_management: Recognize typical nausea and vomiting of pregnancy and apply first-line dietary/pharmacologic management.

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Hyperemesis gravidarum is the severe, complication-prone form of pregnancy-related vomiting (dehydration, electrolyte derangement, weight loss) squarely within this objective's diagnose-severity-and-complications scope.

testable_competencies.hg_management: Recognize hyperemesis gravidarum, assess severity/complications (dehydration, ketonuria, weight loss), and initiate management including antiemetics and admission criteria.

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Ongoing prenatal surveillance across subsequent visits is a direct component of the shared decision-making prenatal care this objective describes.

testable_competencies.routine_surveillance: Apply the recommended content and schedule of subsequent prenatal visits (growth, BP, urine, fetal heart tones) across gestation.

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Objective 80-1 explicitly names 'screening investigations' as part of the prenatal-care shared decision-making it covers (aneuploidy screening, anatomy ultrasound, GBS, glucose screening, etc.).

testable_competencies.screening_selection: Select and interpret appropriate prenatal screening and diagnostic tests by trimester and risk profile, and counsel on their voluntary nature.

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Objective 80-1 explicitly names 'fetal health' as part of its shared decision-making scope; antepartum fetal surveillance (NST, biophysical profile) operationalizes this.

testable_competencies.antepartum_surveillance: Select and interpret antepartum fetal surveillance tests (non-stress test, biophysical profile) and recognize indications for increased surveillance.

entries.title: Counselling of the Pregnant Patient (Nutrition, Lifestyle, Medications, Immunizations, Radiation)

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Nutrition, lifestyle, medication safety, immunization, and radiation-exposure counselling are the concrete content of the shared decision-making prenatal counselling this objective describes.

testable_competencies.pregnancy_counselling: Counsel a pregnant patient on nutrition (e.g., folic acid, iron), lifestyle (substance use, exercise), medication safety, recommended immunizations, and radiation-exposure risk.

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Placenta previa is a leading cause of painless antepartum vaginal bleeding that this objective requires the candidate to diagnose (cause/severity/complications) and manage.

testable_competencies.previa_recognition: Recognize painless antepartum bleeding with placenta previa on imaging and apply the appropriate management plan (expectant vs. delivery, avoiding digital exam).

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Placental abruption is a leading cause of painful antepartum vaginal bleeding requiring urgent diagnosis of severity/complications and management, squarely within this objective's scope.

testable_competencies.abruption_recognition: Recognize painful antepartum bleeding with placental abruption, assess maternal/fetal severity, and initiate urgent management.

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Vasa previa is a rarer but classic cause of antepartum bleeding (with fetal-vessel rupture) within this objective's differential.

testable_competencies.vasa_previa_recognition: Recognize painless vaginal bleeding after membrane rupture with fetal heart rate abnormality as suggestive of vasa previa requiring emergent delivery.

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Exact match: this is the chapter's direct treatment of the named MCC objective 'Preterm labour'.

testable_competencies.ptl_management: Investigate the cause of preterm labour, assess maternal/fetal risk, and initiate management including identification of patients requiring transfer to a centre with neonatal intensive care.

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Preterm prelabour rupture of membranes shares the same maternal/fetal risk-assessment framework as preterm labour when it occurs before term.

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Decision-making around expectant management vs. induction after membrane rupture is a shared decision-making intrapartum-care question this objective covers.

testable_competencies.prom_management: Diagnose rupture of membranes, distinguish term from preterm PROM, and apply the appropriate expectant-management vs. delivery decision framework.

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Surveillance and induction-timing decisions for postterm pregnancy are a shared decision-making prenatal-care question this objective covers.

testable_competencies.postterm_management: Recognize postterm pregnancy and apply appropriate increased fetal surveillance and induction-timing counselling.

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Investigation of cause and management planning after intrauterine fetal demise, including delivery planning and supportive counselling, falls within this objective's shared decision-making scope.

testable_competencies.iufd_management: Recognize intrauterine fetal demise, investigate possible causes, and outline the delivery-planning and bereavement-support approach.

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Exact match: this is the chapter's direct treatment of the named MCC objective.

testable_competencies.iugr_management: Identify modifiable risk factors for IUGR, apply routine fetal growth monitoring, and recognize the need for specialized surveillance/referral and delivery-timing decisions.

entries.title: Macrosomia

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: No dedicated MCC objective exists for excessive fetal growth; macrosomia is the converse abnormal-fetal-weight scenario within the same fetal-growth-assessment domain as objective 118-3.

testable_competencies.macrosomia_recognition: Recognize risk factors and clinical/sonographic suspicion for fetal macrosomia and its implications for mode/timing of delivery (e.g., shoulder dystocia risk).

entries.mcc_evidence_retention_reason: WEAK evidence retained rather than cleared to [] because macrosomia is the converse abnormal-fetal-weight finding within the same clinical domain objective 118-3 addresses, even though no MCC objective names macrosomia directly.

entries.title: Polyhydramnios/Oligohydramnios

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: No dedicated MCC objective exists for amniotic fluid volume abnormalities; oligohydramnios in particular is frequently associated with, and assessed as part of, the same fetal-growth/wellbeing surveillance objective 118-3 addresses.

testable_competencies.fluid_volume_recognition: Recognize oligohydramnios and polyhydramnios on ultrasound and their principal associated maternal/fetal conditions.

entries.mcc_evidence_retention_reason: WEAK evidence retained rather than cleared to [] given the genuine (if indirect) link to fetal wellbeing surveillance covered by objective 118-3.

entries.title: Antenatal Depression

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Antenatal depression is a presentation of the depressed-mood objective, primarily owned by Psychiatry; this unit retains the pregnancy-specific screening-timing and obstetric-risk (e.g., preterm birth, engagement with care) angle.

testable_competencies.antenatal_depression_screening: Recognize risk factors and screening indications for antenatal depression during routine prenatal visits.

entries.cross_discipline_note: Depressed mood/depression diagnostic criteria and primary management are Psychiatry-owned (objective 59-1). This OB unit is retained as a thin DISTINCT_CONTEXT unit for perinatal-specific screening timing and obstetric implications, not duplicating Psychiatry's diagnostic/management content.

entries.title: Multi-Fetal Gestation (Twin Pregnancy) including Twin-Twin Transfusion Syndrome

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: No dedicated MCC objective exists for multiple gestation; chorionicity-based surveillance and delivery planning are shared decision-making questions within the broad intrapartum/postpartum care objective.

testable_competencies.twin_pregnancy_management: Determine chorionicity and apply the corresponding surveillance intensity, and recognize twin-twin transfusion syndrome as a monochorionic-specific complication requiring specialized referral.

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Mode-of-delivery decision-making for an abnormal fetal lie/presentation is a shared decision-making intrapartum-care question this objective covers.

testable_competencies.malpresentation_management: Recognize fetal malpresentation (including breech) on exam/ultrasound and outline mode-of-delivery options (external cephalic version, vaginal breech candidacy, Caesarean).

entries.title: Hypertensive Disorders of Pregnancy (Gestational Hypertension, Preeclampsia, Eclampsia, HELLP)

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Objective 9-1 explicitly requires identifying 'hypertensive urgencies and emergencies'; preeclampsia/eclampsia/HELLP are the paradigmatic pregnancy-specific hypertensive emergencies within this scope.

testable_competencies.hdp_recognition: Diagnose and stage hypertensive disorders of pregnancy (gestational hypertension, preeclampsia, superimposed preeclampsia), recognize severe features and eclampsia/HELLP, and initiate urgent management.

entries.title: Iron and Folate Deficiency Anemia in Pregnancy

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Iron and folate deficiency anemia in pregnancy is a direct instance of the diagnose-cause-severity-complications scope of the anemia objective, with pregnancy-specific screening/treatment.

testable_competencies.anemia_management: Recognize iron and folate deficiency anemia in pregnancy on routine screening and initiate appropriate supplementation.

entries.title: Diabetes Mellitus in Pregnancy (Gestational Diabetes)

testable_competencies.gdm_management: Recognize risk factors and screening approach for gestational diabetes, and outline glycemic-management and delivery-timing implications.

entries.uncertain_reason: No MCC objective exists for diabetes mellitus (gestational or otherwise) anywhere in research/mcc/objectives_registry.json -- confirmed by direct registry search, not just absence from this packet's candidate set. Given gestational diabetes screening/management is core generalist obstetric content, this is classified UNCERTAIN rather than SUPPORTING_KNOWLEDGE/SPECIALIST_DETAIL pending coordinator confirmation of whether this reflects a genuine registry gap.

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Routine antenatal GBS screening (35-37 weeks) is part of the prenatal screening this objective covers.

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Intrapartum antibiotic prophylaxis decision-making for GBS-positive or risk-factor-positive labour is a shared decision-making intrapartum-care question this objective covers.

testable_competencies.gbs_management: Apply antenatal GBS screening and recognize indications for intrapartum antibiotic prophylaxis to prevent early-onset neonatal GBS disease.

mcc_evidence.objective_title: Dysuria, urinary frequency and urgency, and/or pyuria
mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: UTI in pregnancy, including screening for and treating asymptomatic bacteriuria, is a direct instance of this symptom-based objective with pregnancy-specific screening/treatment implications.

testable_competencies.uti_pregnancy_management: Recognize UTI and asymptomatic bacteriuria in pregnancy, apply routine screening, and select pregnancy-safe antibiotic therapy.

entries.title: Infections During Pregnancy

testable_competencies.perinatal_infection_screening: Recognize prenatal screening indications and vertical-transmission-prevention counselling for major congenital/perinatal infections (e.g., toxoplasmosis, rubella, CMV, HSV, HIV, syphilis).

entries.cross_discipline_note: Pathogen-specific diagnosis and management is primarily Infectious Diseases-owned. This OB unit is retained as a thin DISTINCT_CONTEXT unit for prenatal screening indications and vertical-transmission-prevention counselling, not duplicating ID's pathogen-specific content.

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Pregnancy is a major VTE risk state; recognizing pregnancy-specific risk and applying appropriate prophylaxis is within this objective's scope of assessing risk and using best evidence to intervene.

testable_competencies.vte_prevention: Recognize pregnancy/postpartum as a VTE risk state, identify additional risk factors, and apply appropriate thromboprophylaxis.

entries.title: Anatomic Basis of Labour (The Cervix, The Fetus)

testable_competencies.labour_terminology: Foundational terminology for describing fetal station, position, and presentation used throughout the Labour and Delivery content.

entries.zero_question_reason: Specialist-technique, reference/EBM-summary, or foundational-background content with no independently testable generalist competency identified; not planned for dedicated question coverage at this scope stage.

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Assessing and staging labour is the core clinical content of intrapartum care that this objective describes.

testable_competencies.labour_staging: Assess and stage labour (first, second, third, fourth stages) and recognize normal progression.

entries.title: Cardinal Movements of the Fetus During Delivery

testable_competencies.cardinal_movements: Descriptive mechanism of normal fetal descent through the pelvis, framing but not independently tested beyond the labour-progression content above.

entries.zero_question_reason: Specialist-technique, reference/EBM-summary, or foundational-background content with no independently testable generalist competency identified; not planned for dedicated question coverage at this scope stage.

entries.title: Analgesic and Anesthetic Techniques in Labour and Birth

testable_competencies.labour_analgesia_options: Discuss available analgesic/anesthetic options in labour (neuraxial, systemic, non-pharmacologic) and their major contraindications with a patient.

entries.cross_discipline_note: Technique and pharmacology of labour analgesia/anesthesia (epidural, spinal, general) is Anesthesia-owned. This OB unit is retained as a thin DISTINCT_CONTEXT unit for the obstetric-side shared decision-making discussion of options/contraindications, not duplicating Anesthesia's technique content.

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Interpreting intrapartum fetal monitoring to guide shared decision-making about labour management is core intrapartum-care content this objective describes.

testable_competencies.efm_interpretation: Interpret intrapartum fetal heart rate monitoring (baseline, variability, accelerations, decelerations) and apply the corresponding category-based management response.

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Indications for and methods of labour induction are a core shared decision-making intrapartum-care question this objective describes.

testable_competencies.induction_decision: Recognize indications/contraindications for labour induction and outline the major methods (mechanical, prostaglandin, oxytocin).

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Augmenting a labour that has stalled is a shared decision-making intrapartum-care management question this objective describes.

testable_competencies.augmentation_decision: Recognize indications for labour augmentation (e.g., inadequate contractions) and outline the oxytocin-based approach.

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Recognizing abnormal labour progression (dystocia) and its management (including Caesarean-delivery decision-making) is core intrapartum-care content this objective describes.

testable_competencies.dystocia_recognition: Recognize abnormal progression of labour (protraction/arrest disorders) using partogram-based criteria and outline the management options.

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: No dedicated MCC objective names shoulder dystocia; it is a classic time-critical intrapartum emergency within this objective's broad intrapartum-care scope.

testable_competencies.shoulder_dystocia_management: Recognize shoulder dystocia (turtle sign) and apply the stepwise emergency maneuver sequence (McRoberts, suprapubic pressure, etc.).

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: No dedicated MCC objective names cord prolapse; it is a classic time-critical intrapartum emergency within this objective's broad intrapartum-care scope.

testable_competencies.cord_prolapse_management: Recognize umbilical cord prolapse and initiate emergency management (manual elevation of the presenting part, positioning, emergent delivery).

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: No dedicated MCC objective names uterine rupture; it is a classic time-critical intrapartum emergency (particularly in TOLAC) within this objective's broad intrapartum-care scope.

testable_competencies.uterine_rupture_recognition: Recognize signs of uterine rupture (fetal bradycardia, loss of station, abdominal pain, especially in a trial of labour after Caesarean) and initiate emergent management.

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: No dedicated MCC objective names amniotic fluid embolism; it is a rare, catastrophic intrapartum/postpartum event within this objective's broad scope.

testable_competencies.afe_recognition: Recognize the acute presentation of amniotic fluid embolism (sudden hypoxia, hypotension, coagulopathy during/after delivery) as a peripartum emergency requiring immediate resuscitation.

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: No dedicated MCC objective names chorioamnionitis; intrapartum infection recognition/management falls within this objective's broad scope.

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Chorioamnionitis is a cause of intrapartum fever that this fever objective requires the candidate to consider and rule out as a serious cause.

testable_competencies.chorio_recognition: Recognize intrapartum fever with chorioamnionitis and initiate antibiotics and expedited delivery.

entries.title: Meconium (Meconium-Stained Amniotic Fluid)

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Intrapartum recognition of meconium-stained amniotic fluid and the obstetric decision it prompts falls within this objective's broad scope; neonatal management is a separate downstream competency.

testable_competencies.meconium_recognition: Recognize meconium-stained amniotic fluid intrapartum and its implication for delivery-room preparation.

entries.cross_discipline_note: Neonatal resuscitation and meconium aspiration syndrome management are Pediatrics-owned. This OB unit is retained as a thin DISTINCT_CONTEXT unit for intrapartum recognition and the obstetric-side decision this prompts, not duplicating Pediatrics' neonatal-resuscitation content.

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Indications/contraindications for operative vaginal delivery are a shared decision-making intrapartum-care management question this objective describes; instrument-level technique is specialist detail.

testable_competencies.ovd_indications: Recognize indications and contraindications for operative vaginal delivery (forceps or vacuum) without requiring instrument-level technique.

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Recognizing and classifying perineal trauma and the indications for episiotomy are part of the intrapartum/immediate-postpartum care this objective describes.

testable_competencies.perineal_trauma: Classify perineal laceration degree and recognize indications for (and risks of) episiotomy.

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Indications for Caesarean delivery and the shared decision-making counselling around it are core intrapartum-care content this objective describes.

testable_competencies.cs_indications: Recognize indications for Caesarean delivery (elective and emergent) and counsel on associated risks/benefits.

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Counselling a patient with a prior Caesarean about trial of labour vs. repeat Caesarean is a shared decision-making intrapartum-care question this objective describes.

testable_competencies.tolac_counselling: Assess candidacy for trial of labour after Caesarean and counsel on the relative risks/benefits versus repeat Caesarean, including uterine rupture risk.

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Postpartum hemorrhage is the classic, most time-critical postpartum complication within this objective's explicit 'postpartum care' scope.

testable_competencies.pph_management: Recognize postpartum hemorrhage, apply the tone-tissue-trauma-thrombin framework to identify cause, and initiate the stepwise resuscitation/uterotonic management sequence.

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Retained placenta and its management (manual removal, risk of hemorrhage) fall within this objective's postpartum-care scope.

testable_competencies.retained_placenta: Recognize retained placenta as a cause of postpartum hemorrhage risk and outline the management approach (manual removal, associated risks).

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: No dedicated MCC objective names uterine inversion; it is a rare, life-threatening postpartum emergency within this objective's postpartum-care scope.

testable_competencies.uterine_inversion_recognition: Recognize uterine inversion (fundus not palpable abdominally, hemorrhage, shock) and initiate emergency management (manual replacement, resuscitation).

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Postpartum fever requires the candidate to rule out serious/life-threatening causes (endometritis, wound infection, mastitis, VTE) per this objective's scope.

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Working up postpartum fever is a routine postpartum-care question this objective covers.

testable_competencies.postpartum_fever_workup: Apply a structured differential (the '7 Ws'-type framework) to postpartum fever and identify indications for urgent investigation/treatment.

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: No dedicated MCC objective names mastitis; it is a common postpartum/breastfeeding complication within this objective's postpartum-care scope.

testable_competencies.mastitis_management: Recognize mastitis, distinguish it from breast abscess, and initiate management while supporting continued breastfeeding.

entries.title: Postpartum Mood Alterations (Baby Blues, Postpartum Depression, Postpartum Psychosis)

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Postpartum depression is a presentation of the depressed-mood objective, primarily Psychiatry-owned.

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Postpartum psychosis is a presentation of the psychosis objective, primarily Psychiatry-owned, but carries obstetric-context time-critical urgency (risk to mother/infant).

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Screening for postpartum mood changes is part of routine postpartum care.

testable_competencies.postpartum_mood_spectrum: Distinguish baby blues from postpartum depression and postpartum psychosis by timing/severity, and recognize postpartum psychosis as a psychiatric emergency requiring urgent action.

entries.cross_discipline_note: Diagnostic criteria and primary management of depression/psychosis are Psychiatry-owned (objectives 59-1, 86). This OB unit is retained as a DISTINCT_CONTEXT unit given the perinatal-specific epidemiology/screening timing and the obstetric-context urgency of recognizing postpartum psychosis, not duplicating Psychiatry's diagnostic/management content.

entries.title: Postpartum Care (Routine Care, Breastfeeding and Medication Safety)

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Routine postpartum care and breastfeeding/medication-safety counselling are explicit shared decision-making postpartum-care content this objective describes.

testable_competencies.postpartum_counselling: Provide routine postpartum care and counsel on medication safety during breastfeeding.

entries.title: Common Medications in Pregnancy (Reference)

testable_competencies.medication_reference: Reference summary of commonly used obstetric medications; not independently tested at this scope stage given changing dosing/formulary guidance.

entries.zero_question_reason: Specialist-technique, reference/EBM-summary, or foundational-background content with no independently testable generalist competency identified; not planned for dedicated question coverage at this scope stage.

entries.title: Landmark Obstetrics Trials

testable_competencies.landmark_trials: Evidence-summary/EBM reference content framing chapter management recommendations; not independently tested content in its own right.

entries.zero_question_reason: Specialist-technique, reference/EBM-summary, or foundational-background content with no independently testable generalist competency identified; not planned for dedicated question coverage at this scope stage.
